verdict.rationale: The evidence shows kitty runs on macOS, from several hands-on community reports, and on Linux, via the binary install docs covering Linux desktop integration. A single kitty.conf file is the configuration mechanism, and one user notes it fits in a dotfiles repo, which supports reusing the same config across machines. Nothing in the pack shows kitty running on Windows, so the story's three-platform requirement is only two-thirds met. Missing for 10: any evidence of Windows support, and explicit documentation of config portability across operating systems.
